items.t: Sponsored a bill in the Florida House of Representatives banning sanctuary cities in Florida.
items.q: The bill passed 69-47 along party lines in the Republican-controlled House, reported NBC News . The bill was sponsored by Rep. Cord Byrd, a Republican representing the Jacksonville Beach area.

items.t: Said the integrity of free elections is a cornerstone of the Republic and that Florida will uphold the rule of law.
items.q: The integrity of free elections is a cornerstone to our Republic, and in Florida, we will uphold the rule of law.

items.t: Said the Department of Homeland Security's immigration database would be the best tool he uses to check the citizenship status of registered voters if it were reliable.

record.t: Sponsored a bill banning sanctuary cities that passed the Florida House 69-47.
record.q: The bill passed 69-47 along party lines in the Republican-controlled House, reported NBC News . The bill was sponsored by Rep. Cord Byrd, a Republican representing the Jacksonville Beach area.

record.t: Was appointed by Governor Ron DeSantis as Florida's 37th Secretary of State.
record.q: Secretary of State Cord Byrd was appointed by Governor Ron DeSantis as Florida’s 37th Secretary of State.

record.t: Served three terms in the Florida House of Representatives before being appointed Secretary of State.
record.q: Prior to being appointed Secretary of State, he served three terms in the Florida House of Representatives.

record.t: Served as Chair of the Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council.
record.q: Secretary Byrd previously served as Chair of the Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council helping Florida’s state agencies remain the standard bearer for cybersecurity across the nation.

record.t: Was appointed by Governor DeSantis as chair of the Florida Commission for the United States Semiquincentennial.
record.q: Governor DeSantis appointed Secretary Byrd as chair of the Florida Commission for the United States Semiquincentennial

record.t: Proposed a bill that would allow local law enforcement officers to coordinate with federal agencies in enforcing federal immigration law.
record.q: Republican Florida State Representative Cord Byrd says his bill would allow local law enforcement officers to coordinate with federal agencies in the enforcement of federal immigration law.

record.t: Announced, together with Governor DeSantis and Attorney General James Uthmeier, the arrest of 20 defendants charged with illegal voting.

record.t: Provided election readiness reminders ahead of the November 3, 2026 General Election.

record.t: Announced that all 67 counties offer early voting from October 24-31 ahead of the 2026 General Election.

record.t: Was among the officials whose attempts to keep the Justice Department from getting involved in a lawsuit regarding the state's voting laws were denied by a federal judge.
